items.title: DCUC Warns Trump That 10% Credit Card Rate Cap Could Hurt Military Families
items.why: A rate cap would reshape card economics across tiers, so track this policy debate closely.
items.summary_ai: The Defense Credit Union Council urges the President against a 10% credit card rate cap, citing harm to military families.
items.take: A rate cap would reshape card economics across tiers, so track this policy debate closely.
